title: Virtual network sampling method using LinkedIn
author: Kozłowski, Kaliszewski, et al.

steps.title: Build list of potential respondents
steps.instruction: Use LinkedIn Sales Navigator (Professional) to search for individuals who belong to the study population and compile a list of their profiles.

substeps.instruction: Obtain a LinkedIn Sales Navigator subscription (Professional tier); a free introductory period is available.
Prepare a list of target organisations (e.g., shipping lines, freight forwarders) that represent the respondents' workplaces.
Set search filters such as location, industry, position, seniority, and any other criteria required by the study.
Run the search within the researcher’s own network – first‑, second‑, or third‑degree connections – and within relevant professional groups.
Iterate the search as needed, relying on a diverse initial network of first‑degree contacts and allowing sufficient time for additional iterations.

steps.title: Send connection invitations
steps.instruction: Invite the people from the compiled list to connect, making them first contacts of the researcher.

substeps.instruction: Export or record the LinkedIn profiles identified in Step 1.
Use LinkedIn Helper (paid tool with a free introductory period) to automatically send a large number of personalized connection invitations; links must not be included in the invitations.
Craft invitation text that states the researcher’s affiliation (preferably in the same industry as the invitees) and provides a clear justification for the connection request.
Reserve time and resources for ongoing correspondence with invitees, providing near‑round‑the‑clock support to accommodate global time zones.

steps.title: Distribute survey invitations
steps.instruction: Invite the newly connected contacts to participate in the study’s questionnaire or poll.

substeps.instruction: After connections are accepted, confirm that a diverse panel of respondents has been assembled.
Prepare the survey invitation wording, emphasizing incentives such as access to the survey report, previous publications, or other attractive offers.
Choose the delivery method: simple polls can be run directly on LinkedIn; more advanced questionnaires should be hosted on an external platform (e.g., LimeSurvey).
If required, apply quota selection to ensure the sample matches desired characteristics (e.g., geographic distribution, company size).

Optionally, use simple programming placeholders (e.g., {First Name}) to personalize messages, indicating mutual connections or shared interest groups; note that Asian names that use only initials or family names may reveal the invitation as computer‑generated.
Send the survey invitations and monitor response rates.
